title: Token Hotel
tagline: A on-chain board game where you buy, build, and upgrade hotels
description:
How to play:

- Roll a 6-sided dice to move around the board
- If you land on an empty space, you can build and mint a hotel NFT
- You can create a token-bound account for the hotel NFT, which can be upgraded to receive room tokens, allowing you to earn more income.
- If another player lands on your hotel, they will pay ETH, which will be transferred to your hotel's token-bound account.
how_its_made:
I developed the dApp using Scaffold-ETH 2. It uses NextJS, RainbowKit, Hardhat, Wagmi, and Typescript.  I deployed my contracts on the Scroll, Chiado and Stylus Testnet for Faucet NFT.

I used the following technologies:
- Scroll - I deployed the contract on Scroll Testnet for cheap gas fee
- Arbitrum - I deployed the contract on Stylus Testnet for cheap gas fee
- Gnosis Chain - I deployed the contract on Chiado Testnet for cheap gas fee
